You are fixing ONE safety gate in the OBE podcast repo at /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast. Do NOT git commit, git push, or open a PR. Do NOT send anything externally. Do not load skills or call MCP/Apps. Subscription/OAuth only, zero API spend. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp on every python call. Files you may change: server/pipeline/media_gates.py, tests/test_media_gates.py and tests/test_media_gates_integration.py. Nothing else. Never write media into /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast/episodes/ -- keep every render in YOUR task directory.

THE SITUATION: episode 2026-06-10-fred-cho renders correctly now (four render defects were fixed today) but the transfer / publishable_render gate refuses it:
  FAIL AV_SYNC_DIVERGENCE mode=av_anchors anchor_s=945.728 mapped_source_anchor_s=1517.494333 av_divergence_ms=+57.000 threshold_ms=40.000 audio_confidence=0.405
plus a second anchor reporting +189.5ms at confidence 0.136.

THE RENDER IS IN SYNC. That was established by independent measurement, not opinion. Using normalized FFT cross-correlation of 10ms RMS energy envelopes, six cut-free windows INSIDE single boundary-map pieces were located in the source composite and compared against what the boundary map predicts:
  edited  215.8-255.8s -> mapped 702.66  measured 702.66  delta  -1.3ms  peak 0.987
  edited  342.1-382.1s -> mapped 829.00  measured 829.00  delta  +0.0ms  peak 1.000
  edited  475.5-515.5s -> mapped 985.03  measured 985.04  delta  -6.1ms  peak 0.985
  edited  563.8-603.8s -> mapped 1094.50 measured 1094.50 delta  +0.2ms  peak 1.000
  edited 1070.0-1110.0s -> mapped 1713.00 measured 1713.00 delta  +0.0ms  peak 1.000
  edited 1530.9-1570.9s -> mapped 2208.00 measured 2208.00 delta  +0.4ms  peak 1.000
The method was validated in BOTH directions so it can be trusted to see a real offset: the composite correlated against itself gives peak 1.0000 at 0.0ms, and a 192k AAC round-trip of the same audio gives peak 0.9999 at 0.0ms.

WHY THE GATE IS WRONG: read server/pipeline/media_gates.py validate_transfer (~line 796), _validate_transfer_impl (~line 826) and _match_audio. In av_anchors mode the gate takes a 0.25 SECOND slice of edited audio and searches a plus/minus 0.5 second source window, then treats the single maximum correlation value as proof the anchor is measurable, with min_audio_confidence=0.4 as the only quality test. A quarter second of conversational speech cannot locate itself: the failing anchor scored 0.405, clearing that floor by five thousandths, and its answer moved to +87ms, +57.5ms and -268ms as the window was centred and widened, with neighbouring 0.25s slices scattering from -483ms to +472ms. The second anchor's +189.7ms had confidence 0.136 and flipped sign entirely when centred. Those numbers are noise, and the gate reported them as divergence.

THE FIX -- a locatability contract, not a looser bound:
1. Keep threshold_ms=40.0, keep min_strong_anchors=3, keep fail-closed, and keep min_audio_confidence as ONE necessary input. Do NOT widen the threshold, do NOT skip the gate for long programs, and do NOT simply raise the confidence floor until this episode passes. Raising the floor would reject this false anchor without proving the new number separates real matches from false ones, and you must say so explicitly if you are tempted.
2. Choose anchor windows that CAN be located: the window must lie wholly INSIDE one boundary-map piece (never straddle a cut, which is what makes the content non-contiguous with the source), and it must be long enough to be distinctive. The measurements above used 40 seconds where the piece allowed; use the piece's available length with a margin, with a sensible minimum, and fall back to shorter only when no piece is long enough. If a nominal anchor cannot be given such a window, that anchor is UNMEASURABLE, not divergent.
3. Make measurability require quality, not one maximum: a high normalized peak AND prominence over the best competing peak outside a small neighbourhood. The evidence says a real match here scores 0.985 to 1.000 while noise scores 0.04 to 0.4, so the separation is wide; pick your bar from the fixtures you build, not from this one episode, and state your reasoning.
4. Energy-envelope correlation at a 10ms hop located every one of the six windows. Raw-PCM correlation over the same windows did not. Use whichever your fixtures show to be reliable, and say why.
5. Only an anchor that passes locatability may emit AV_SYNC_DIVERGENCE. Everything else is recorded as unmeasurable and the existing replacement-candidate mechanism seeks the three measurable anchors the quorum needs.

TESTS you must add, with fixtures built by ffmpeg lavfi in the test's tmp_path (do NOT depend on the real episode media, which is not in git):
  * a program that is genuinely in sync must PASS,
  * the same program with a known injected audio offset of about 60ms and again about 200ms must FAIL with AV_SYNC_DIVERGENCE (this is the test that proves the gate still detects real desync),
  * an anchor region that is unlocatable (digital silence, or a repeated identical loop) must be reported UNMEASURABLE and must NOT produce a divergence failure,
  * a program where too few anchors are measurable must still FAIL CLOSED on the quorum.
Keep the existing tests in those two files green.

VERIFY BEFORE YOU FINISH and paste the real output into your final message:
  cd /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp python3 -m pytest tests/test_media_gates.py tests/test_media_gates_integration.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
and a REAL call of validate_transfer against the rendered program at /tmp/claude-1000/-mnt-d-drive-repos-loop-factory/b41a49f1-2844-4cf6-ba25-2991cffeabad/scratchpad/e104-shadow/episodes/2026-06-10-fred-cho/processed/angle_switched.mp4 with its .boundaries.json as time_map and /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast/episodes/2026-06-10-fred-cho/processed/composite.mp4 as source, mode av_anchors, printing passed plus every anchor's classification, correlation quality and divergence. Those artifacts are READ-ONLY to you. A claim without executed output is not done. Leave the working tree dirty -- the coordinator lands it.
tasks.verified: The fixed gate accepts Fred's rendered program, which independent envelope correlation measured in sync to within 6.1ms across six windows, while still failing the same program with 60ms and 200ms of injected audio offset, and it keeps threshold_ms=40 with the 3-anchor fail-closed quorum
